doc_notice: Iyi ni inyandiko yahinduwe hifashishijwe imashini. Inyandiko y'Icyongereza ni yo ifite agaciro.
status_footnote: Igihe cyo gukora kibarwa hakurikijwe igenzura: "irakora" n'"ikora nabi" bibarwa nk'ikora; "ntikora" na "yarafunzwe" bibarwa nk'idakora. Imirongo: imiterere mibi kurusha iyindi kuri buri munsi (UTC), iminsi 30 iheruka.
readme_off_note: **Bifunze mu buryo busanzwe (OFF) — bisaba WLM_PERMITTED={code} n'uruhushya rw'ubikoresha (operator).**
cov_intro: Ibyo Fontes igeraho muri buri fasi y'ubutabera: inkiko zayo n'ubwoko bw'amategeko yayo, buri kimwe kigaragaza niba cyagezweho cyangwa kitagezweho; inkomoko n'amabwiriza yazo; n'ibyo Fontes itageraho n'impamvu. Imibare isomwa ngo byagezweho + igice½ / imirongo yose, bityo `5+1½/8` bisobanura imirongo 5 yagezweho n'umurongo 1 wagezweho igice, mu mirongo 8. Byakozwe na `scripts/catalogue.py`; ntukabihindure n'intoki.
cov_reliability: **Uko intonde z'inkiko zizewe.** Niba buri murongo wagezweho bimenyekana hasomwe kode ya adapter. Ariko intonde z'inkiko n'amategeko ubwazo zateguwe na agent za AI hashingiwe ku bumenyi bwazo, zigenzurwa ku rubuga rwa Leta igihe rwashoboraga gufungurwa. Imbuga nyinshi z'inkiko za Leta zari zifunze cyangwa zitagerwaho, bityo kuba hari reference ivugwa ntibisobanura buri gihe ko urwo rupapuro rwasomwe. Ibihugu byanditseho UNVERIFIED nta nkomoko ya Leta na mba byari bifite. Fata izi ntonde nk'umushinga ugomba kugenzurwa, si nk'ububasha bwemewe.
cov_last_column: **Inkingi ya nyuma** ivuga, ku kintu cyose Fontes itageraho byuzuye, niba gishobora kugerwaho na gato: 🟢 kiraboneka (inkomoko ya Leta cyangwa ifite uruhushya irakitangaza; Fontes ntirakubaka), 🔒 cyarafunzwe (inkomoko irahari ariko robots.txt, amabwiriza, urukuta rwa bot, kwinjira cyangwa kwishyura bitubuza), ⚫ ntikiri kuri interineti (byagenzuwe: ntigitangazwa kuri interineti), ❓ ntibizwi. Buri cyanditswe kivuga icyo gishingiyeho: 'fetched <date>' bisobanura ko urupapuro rwafunguwe uwo munsi; 'search result only' ntibikomeye cyane. Imbuga zitinda zigahagarara (time out) iyo zigezweho zivuye mu Bwongereza zanditseho ntibizwi cyangwa cyarafunzwe hamwe n'ibisobanuro; geo-blocking ntibyemejwe.

cov_scorecard_intro: Ifasi y'ubutabera ibarwa nk'igerwaho iyo Fontes igeze byuzuye nibura ku gice kimwe muri bibiri: imanza zibanziriza (precedents) z'urukiko rukuru rusanzwe rwayo (ruhwanye na Yargıtay), cyangwa Itegeko Nshinga ryayo n'amategeko y'ibanze (urwego rw'itegeko n'urwisumbuyeho). Amategeko yo ku rwego rwa kabiri n'inkiko zo hasi ntibibarwa. ✅ byuzuye (icyuho gito cyagaragajwe), ◐ icyuho (hari ikintu gitangazwa kibura, cyangwa inkomoko ifunze kugeza habonetse uruhushya), ❌ nta na kimwe. Ibyemezo bishingiye ku bushishozi biri muri research/scorecard_overrides.json.
